title: Soufriere Hills Volcano
author: NASA/GSFC/METI/ERSDAC/JAROS, and U.S./Japan ASTER Science Team
description: In this ASTER image of Soufriere Hills Volcano on Montserrat in the Caribbean, continued eruptive activity is evident by the extensive smoke and ash plume streaming towards the west-southwest. Significant eruptive activity began in 1995, forcing the authorities to evacuate more than 7,000 of the island's original population of 11,000.
